map.由样本标准差与测量次数求 A 类标准不确定度 使用指南: Type A Standard Uncertainty from Sample Standard Deviation and Measurement Count User Guide
map.输入样本标准差 s 与独立测量次数 n，按 u_A = s / √n 计算 A: Enter the sample standard deviation s and the number of independent measurements n and compute the Type A standard uncertainty as u_A = s / √n (statistical evaluation), used to evaluate an uncertainty component from repeated observations.
map.输入样本标准差 s 与测量次数 n，求 A 类标准不确定度。: Enter the sample standard deviation s and number of measurements n to get the Type A standard uncertainty.
map.：s = sqrt(sum((xi-xbar)^2)/(n-1))。例：5 次测: : s = sqrt(sum((xi−xbar)²)/(n−1)). Example: five readings of 10.001, 10.003, 9.999, 10.002, 10.000 give s ≈ 0.0016.
map.：u_A=s/√n=1.5/4=0.3750。测量次数翻倍只能把 u_A 降到约: : u_A = s/√n = 1.5/4 = 0.3750. Doubling the number of measurements only brings u_A down to about 70%, so the returns from increasing n diminish.
map.用统计法（重复观测）评定的不确定度分量。: An uncertainty component evaluated statistically (from repeated observations).
map.B 类用非统计信息（证书/经验/手册）。: For class B, use non-statistical information (certificates, experience, manuals).
